logic.event: At every UTC hour quarter-hour boundary minute (minute-of-hour in {0,15,30,45}) plus fixed phase_offset_minutes, start one long-only spot holding window of hold_minutes. Entry is at that minute open; exit at the open exactly hold_minutes later. Windows never overlap because hold_minutes<=3 and event spacing is 15 minutes. At each entry, use available account cash; no leverage, no cross-event open position, no transfers.
logic.causality: The deterministic UTC schedule is known before the event. Treat event signal as available 60 seconds before entry; execution is the actual next one-minute open at the event timestamp. Exit is scheduled at the next open after the fixed holding window. No candle close from the entry or holding window is used to decide entry.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT unlevered spot account per asset/parameter set; cash compounds between non-overlapping event windows; all positions liquidated by the scheduled exit, no interest.

parameters.impact_model: 0.5 * sample_stdev(previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns) * sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete UTC daily quote-volume ADV)
parameters.exchange_filters: Frozen Binance exchange-info snapshot with PRICE_FILTER, LOT_SIZE, NOTIONAL; adverse tick rounding, lot floor, 5-minute pre-execution VWAP proxy for percent-price filters.

sources.citation: Shanaev et al. (2023), Turn-of-the-candle effect in bitcoin returns, Heliyon 9:e14236, DOI 10.1016/j.heliyon.2023.e14236
sources.use: Authors report positive BTC minute returns at exact 15-minute candle-turn minutes on 2013–2021 samples; their exchange-specific strategy relies on a Bitfinex volume-based zero-fee threshold around $5,000. Motivation only; this project tests BTC/ETH with current repository cost assumptions and does not assume the effect persists.

failure_gates.phase_specificity: Mean 1x return across exact phase-0 variants must exceed both predeclared phase-1 and phase-2 control means for each asset; otherwise no event-anomaly candidate is retained.
failure_gates.interpretation: Historical repeated-data screen; not untouched final holdout and not live-profit evidence.

logic.event: At every UTC hour quarter-hour boundary minute (minute-of-hour in {0,15,30,45}) plus fixed phase_offset_minutes, start one long-only spot holding window of hold_minutes. Entry is at that minute open; exit at the open exactly hold_minutes later. Windows never overlap because hold_minutes<=3 and event spacing is 15 minutes. At each entry, use available account cash; no leverage, no cross-event open position, no transfers.
logic.causality: The deterministic UTC schedule is known before the event. Treat event signal as available 60 seconds before entry; execution is the actual next one-minute open at the event timestamp. Exit is scheduled at the next open after the fixed holding window. No candle close from the entry or holding window is used to decide entry.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT unlevered spot account per asset/parameter set; cash compounds between non-overlapping event windows; all positions liquidated by the scheduled exit, no interest.
